text:
oncall-bot: [INCIDENT] 2032104567 - spike in gateway 5xx/timeouts observed in eu-west. Alerting on-call rotation.
Sam: I'm paged, looking.
Avery: seeing ~20% 502s for /v1/generate, median latency up, tail latency spikes. Some clients time out around 30s.
Priya: quick check of traces — many spans are missing span_id and sampling=false. Traces are showing a lot of "spanserializer: no id". Hard to tie errors to backend.
Jordan: ugh. if trace/span ids are missing we can't correlate frontend->model. Could be a tracer agent downgrade or env var change.
Sam: can we temporarily bump sampling to 100% across gateway+proxy for troubleshooting? Also enable verbose gateway logs for 5m.
oncall-bot: Pager duty: handoff to Sam (sre rotation).
Sam: Priya, can you roll the sampling config? Use jumpbox -> kube patch, then restart gateway canary: 
```
kubectl -n prod patch configmap observability-config --type merge -p '{"data":{"trace.sample_rate":"1.0"}}'
kubectl -n prod rollout restart deployment/gateway --selector=canary=true
```
Priya: running the patch now. Note: restarting gateway pods might drop some warm connections; doing canary first.
Support-Bot: Customer impact summary: 12 customers reported increased errors in the last 10m; top affected tenants: enterprise-nyc, finance-ops, partner-alpha.
Avery: looking at model-host logs — I see repeated "connection reset by peer" around the same timestamps we saw 502s. Some hosts show OOM messages too.
Jordan: could be keepalive/idle timeout mismatch between gateway and model-host after last proxy TLS tweak. I'll check PROXY_KEEPALIVE and the kernel update history on nodes.
Sam: mitigation plan (live): 1) set trace.sample_rate=1.0 for 5m 2) enable debug gateway logs 3) identify offending model-hosts from new traces and cordon/replace nodes 4) apply lightweight fallback route to smaller model to reduce latencies.
Priya: sample_rate patched at 10:16 UTC. Traces are starting to include span_id/trace_id. We can finally correlate.
Avery: confirmed — traces now show full span ids. Correlating errors points to model-host-12 (worker-2245) reporting repeated OOM/kill events.
Jordan: model-host-12 sits on node gpu-7 which had a kernel/security update rolled yesterday. I see dmesg lines: "OOM killer invoked" and frequent process restarts.
Sam: I'm cordoning gpu-7 and launching a replacement node. Also creating incident ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-4321 for tracking.
Support-Bot: Customer count with errors decreased from 12 -> 3 after initial mitigation; partial degradation remains for three tenants.
Avery: deploying a stopgap instrumentation patch at gateway: if incoming request lacks x-request-id header, generate UUID and inject as x-req-id so logs can be tied even when upstream doesn't propagate ids. Small patch rolling to canary now.
Priya: request-id fallback deployed to canary, access logs now include req_id field for those requests.
Sam: handing operational ownership to Jordan for deeper RCA and post-incident items. Jordan, you're primary now @Jordan.
Jordan: taking over. I'll coordinate node replacement and follow-on telemetry changes. ETA for full recovery ~45m. Will post updates every 15m.
Sam: followups to capture: - set permanent baseline trace sampling to avoid blindspots - add healthcheck to detect missing span IDs at ingest layer - add pre-upgrade checklist for kernel/security updates on GPU nodes - document request-id fallback as a temporary mitigation.
oncall-bot: Incident acknowledged and assigned to Jordan. Severity: sev2. Start time: 2032104567.
Jordan: noted. I'll escalate to infra leads for kernel rollback if node replacement doesn't stabilize. Posting status in 15.
